newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Panmure cuts Hepworth figures.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Panmure cuts Hepworth figures.

text.p: Earnings estimates for building products group Hepworth Plc were cut by Panmure Gordon, following a meeting with executives from the company, dealers said on Thursday.
For 1997, Panmure cut to 57.9 million stg from 68.5 million, while for 1998 it reduced its profit estimate to 65.1 million stg from 75.0 million.
That compares with a market consensus of 69 million stg for the current year and 75 million for 1998, according to the Estimate Directory.

Panmure rated the stock a "hold," warning that current trading was tough and the dividend cover looked thin, though the appointment of new senior management at the company could spell some positive news in coming months.
Hepworth said in April its chief executive John Carter had quit for personal reasons. Sir Roland Smith recently quit as chairman to be replaced by Jeremy Lancaster.
Analysts at Panmure were not immediately available for comment.
The stock was unchanged at 246-1/2p by 1030 GMT.
